content:
- Overestimate prices after recent sentiment spikes (especially when sentiment > 0.67), especially in the 10-15 day horizon.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is low or negative (sentiment < 0.33), particularly in the 5-10 day horizon.
- Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts; model should not overshoot by >5% in 3-5 day windows unless sentiment is strongly bullish.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 1-2% per day until convergence.
- Lag correction: if true outcome is >5% above forecast at day 10+ of 30d horizon, adjust downward by 0.5-1% per day for next 3 days.
- Sentiment-driven bias: when sentiment > 0.75, forecast should be 1-2% higher than historical mean; when sentiment < 0.3, forecast should be 1-2% lower.
